verdict.rationale: First-party CDP docs describe webhooks that deliver real-time HTTP notifications for events across the integration. They are registrable as subscriptions, including watching up to 100 wallet addresses under one `wallet.activity.multi` subscription, with at-least-once guaranteed delivery. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and documentation detail on the full event catalog, signature verification, and programmatic subscription management (API/CLI).
